pinned_icon_mirror.note: Pinned mirror of Google Cloud product icons; original Google icon geometry and colors are retained.

layout_decision: The primary event-to-partner delivery path is left-to-right. Scheduler and Reconciler occupy a separate support lane; Firestore and Secret Manager are placed beneath their primary consumers. Use short orthogonal segments for control paths and keep partner test/public trust boundary visibly separate. The lower state diagram separates normal, transient, terminal, unknown and manual-redrive paths.
verification: Design artifact only. CI validates SVG structure, icon hashes and PNG rendering; no GCP deployment or Cloud verification is implied.

style_attribution.note: Diagram Design conventions adapted; official Google Cloud icons retain original colors and geometry.
